# XEVQOR

> Zero-dependency, offline-first client-side cryptography and privacy utility suite. 100% browser-executed via Web Crypto API with zero cookies, zero localStorage, zero analytics, and strict `connect-src 'none'` network isolation.

## Core Architecture & Security Posture
- **Domain**: https://xevqor.my.id/
- **Open-Source Mirror**: https://github.com/xevqor/xevqor.github.io
- **Cryptographic Primitives**: PBKDF2-SHA256 (600,000 iterations), AES-256-GCM (Chunked with anti-truncation per-chunk AAD), 96-bit random IV, 128-bit salt, CSPRNG (`crypto.getRandomValues` with modulo-bias rejection sampling).
- **HTTP Security Score**: 135/100 (Grade A+) on Mozilla HTTP Observatory; strict SHA-256 inline script CSP, HSTS preload, COOP/COEP/CORP isolation.
- **Offline PWA**: Service Worker (`sw.js`) caches static assets locally; zero user inputs or keys ever touch disk or network.

## Tools & Modules
- [XEVQOR Suite Index](https://xevqor.my.id/): Main portal launching all 9 client-side privacy and cryptographic utilities.
- [Keypass](https://xevqor.my.id/keypass/): High-entropy CSPRNG password and passphrase generator with rejection sampling.
- [Encrypt](https://xevqor.my.id/encrypt/): Streaming Chunked AES-256-GCM file encryption and decryption with randomized output filenames (`xevqorvaultXXXXXX.xqr`) to prevent metadata leakage.
- [Cipherlink](https://xevqor.my.id/cipherlink/): Serverless encrypted dead-drop links storing ciphertext exclusively in the URL `#fragment` (never sent to HTTP servers) with 45-second auto-wipe clipboard protection.
- [Stego](https://xevqor.my.id/stego/): Lossless PNG LSB (Least Significant Bit) steganography hiding AES-256-GCM encrypted payloads inside images while stripping EXIF metadata.
- [Nebula](https://xevqor.my.id/nebula/): Zero-width Unicode steganography encoding AES-256-GCM ciphertext into invisible characters (`8 chars/byte + 352 fixed overhead`).
- [Hash](https://xevqor.my.id/hash/): Local file and text cryptographic digest calculator (SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512) with constant-time comparison.
- [JWT Inspector](https://xevqor.my.id/jwt/): Offline JSON Web Token header/payload decoder and HMAC/RSA/ECDSA signature verifier.
- [Nano](https://xevqor.my.id/nano/): Ephemeral volatile scratchpad held strictly in RAM with instant zero-trace wipe.
- [Dice](https://xevqor.my.id/dice/): Unbiased CSPRNG 3D multi-dice entropy generator displaying faces, sum, mean, Shannon entropy bits, and session history.

## Verification & Reproducibility
- [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xevqor/xevqor.github.io/main/SHA256SUMS.txt): Bit-for-bit SHA-256 manifest verifying parity between production (`xevqor.my.id`) and GitHub Pages (`xevqor.github.io`).
